title: Jovial Juicy French San Marzano Tomato Gratin
description: A sour and shattering lazy-sunday French dish featuring San Marzano tomatoes, mother-sauce-base, and low-sodium friendly ingredients, perfect for a relaxing day at home. This dish is a twist on traditional French cuisine with a Basque influence.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Butter a 9x13 inch baking dish and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the crushed San Marzano tomatoes, mother sauce, and minced garlic.
Add the shredded gruyere cheese, thyme sprig, salt, and pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Slice the day-old french bread into 1 inch thick slices and arrange in the prepared baking dish.
Pour the tomato mixture over the bread slices and make sure they are fully coated.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
